result.rationale: A closed take-private, the proven Delaware successor and current NOVA Fund II evidence establish one missing, qualifying private platform; no later platform ownership transfer was found.

identityResolution.predecessorAliases: UGE International Ltd.; UGE; TSXV:UGE; OTCQB:UGEIF
identityResolution.legalHistory: UGE Ltd. and UGE Consulting Services amalgamated, then amalgamated with purchaser 1000896425 Ontario Ltd.; the survivor continued to Delaware and became UGE International Inc. on 2024-08-22.
identityResolution.subsidiaries: UGE Consulting Services was amalgamated; complete current subsidiary list NOT_PUBLICLY_DISCLOSED.
identityResolution.boundary: Count UGE once. Projects, SPVs, development rights, tax-equity and financing vehicles are underlying operations.

currentOwners.stake: Holdco is UGE's 100% direct shareholder. NOVA bought about 69.2% of pre-close shares/majority control; 30.8% rolled into Holdco Class A LP units. Post-close economics NOT_PUBLICLY_DISCLOSED.

ownershipResolution.rolloverHolders: Nick Blitterswyk; Wendy Liu; Xiangrong Xie; Junfei Lieu; Daniel Gastel. They became indirect Holdco LP investors, not direct UGE shareholders; later holdings NOT_PUBLICLY_DISCLOSED.
ownershipResolution.formerOwnerFinding: No former qualifying infrastructure-manager owner identified; dispersed public shareholders are not separate owner records.

operatingResolution.profile: Vertically integrated developer, builder, financier, owner and operator of U.S. community/commercial solar and battery storage.
operatingResolution.marketsCustomers: Initial 11-state footprint: NY,NJ,ME,CA,PA,OR,TX,IL,MD,VA,MA; serves businesses, households and communities through subscriptions/long-term contracts.
operatingResolution.scale: Over 500 MW project experience. Operating portfolio reached 24 MW across six states in 2025-01. In 2025-06 UGE acquired rights to 122 projects: about 60 MWdc late-stage in NY and 2.35 GW early-stage across 14 states.
operatingResolution.qualification: Qualifies as infrastructure because it owns/operates long-lived distributed generation and storage with contracted cash flows.

acquisitionExitCheck.terms: C$2.00 cash per non-rolled share; 10,372,941 shares/30.8% rolled. Aggregate price and Holdco capitalization NOT_PUBLICLY_DISCLOSED.
acquisitionExitCheck.closing: Securityholders approved 2024-07-31; court approved 2024-08-06; arrangement effective 2024-08-15; TSXV delisting effective at close 2024-08-19.
acquisitionExitCheck.later: NOVA still marks UGE Current and identified it as a Fund II platform in 2026-04. No platform sale, recapitalization, merger, insolvency/restructuring or signed pending ownership transfer found through the as-of date. OYA was a project-rights acquisition from a bankrupt seller, not a UGE ownership change.
